integrity: Finite verification used exact arithmetic and was rerun from the supplied standalone source. The infinite claims rest on the included analytic Markov-chain proof. No external independent verification is represented.
scientific_limitations: Applies to fully overlapping complete layers, discrete independent random best responses to exactly two integer-threshold coordination games, tie retention, and specified large-population scaling. Does not cover sparse graphs or arbitrary nonuniform individual activity; the base study supplementary PDF could not be read.
title: Entropy-barrier selection and exponential consensus latency in two-layer coordination games
